title: Release Train — Weekly Readiness Prep (Mar 4 go/no-go)
content:
Context:
- Weekly release-train sync to confirm go/no-go for the Mar 4 launch window. Prep notes + lightweight checklist for the meeting.
- Audience: eng leads (runtime, infra, console), product, SRE, QA, release manager.

Agenda (15-20m):
1) Quick status roll (2m per lead) — green/yellow/red + 1-sentence blocker
2) Go/No-Go criteria check (walk through checklist)
3) Outstanding blockers & mitigations (decide owners)
4) Action items and rollback/fallback confirmation
5) Vote: go / soft-go / no-go and contingency next steps

Go/No-Go Criteria (must be green or acceptable yellow with mitigation):
- Critical bugs: none open that block checkout or heavy core flows (JIRA-REL-4821 referenced)
- Performance SLOs: 95th p50 latency at or below target on canary (see perf dashboard)
- Infra capacity: dedicated pool provisioned and smoke-tested (infra lead sign-off)
- Security/compliance: final audit checklist complete OR temporary exception approved by security
- Rollback path: validated and rehearsed, owner assigned

Current checklist (quick status inline):
- Canary deploy to staging: DONE (Tom) — smoke pass, 1 minor warn (see PR #987 notes)
- End-to-end QA: IN_PROGRESS (Priya) — 4 flaky tests, investigating (JIRA-REL-4899)
- Load test (50% expected load): DONE (SRE) — passed, CPU spike on GPU node at peak 75% — acceptable
- DB migration dry-run: DONE (Jorge) — no schema drift found
- Feature flag gating: TODO (Product) — gating rule + kill-switch need final doc
- Observability: partial (console dashboards created, alert thresholds pending)

Outstanding blockers (short):
- Flaky e2e tests (PRI): blocking final QA pass. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-03-02. Next: triage test logs + create smaller repro ticket.
- Feature flag kill-switch doc not created: Owner: Product (Aisha sending template). ETA: 2026-03-03 EOD.
- Final alert thresholds not tuned: Owner: SRE (Tom). ETA: 2026-03-03 morning.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Unexpected model performance regressions under real traffic. Mitigation: Canary + canary traffic cap + auto-fallback to previous model version. Owner: eng-serving-runtime.
- Risk: Provisioning delay for Dedicated pool. Mitigation: Reserve small spillover capacity in cloud account and notify sales for dedicated customers. Owner: Infra (Jorge).

Decisioning script (for meeting):
- Read each criterion, call out green/yellow/red and mitigation.
- If all green => vote GO. If 1-2 yellows with acceptable mitigation => vote SOFT-GO (conditional). If any red (blocking) => NO-GO.
- Required voters: Release Manager + Eng Lead + SRE + Product PM.

Action items (to assign in meeting):
- Priya: finish flaky test triage + create repro tickets (due 2026-03-02).
- Tom: finalize alert thresholds + post dashboard links (due 2026-03-03 10:00).
- Jorge: confirm dedicated pool provisioning + fallback capacity plan (due 2026-03-03 EOD).
- Aisha (me): publish kill-switch doc template + feature flag gating doc, add to Confluence, ping security for sign-off (due 2026-03-03 EOD).
- Release manager: run rollback drill with infra (schedule 30m) and confirm runbook location (due 2026-03-03).

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- If Priya not green by meeting, escalate to eng lead for triage call immediately after sync.
- Consider delaying non-blocking UX polish until after launch (saves QA cycles).
- Reminder: update the release Slack channel with final decision and link to runbook.

Post-meeting follow-up template (to send after vote):
- Status: GO / SOFT-GO / NO-GO
- Key blockers remaining (if any) + owners + due dates
- Rollback plan summary + runbook link
- Customer impact statement (if NO-GO) + comms owner

Linked tickets to call out in meeting:
- JIRA-REL-4821 (critical bug triage)
- JIRA-REL-4899 (e2e flaky tests)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/987 (canary notes)

Unresolved questions (to raise):
- Do we allow a SOFT-GO with 1 unresolved minor QA item? (need product + SRE alignment)
- Are the current alert thresholds sufficient for model-related anomalies? (SRE + ML lead)

Quick checklist for meeting pack (what I will upload to the Slack channel before meeting):
- One-pager status doc (this file)
- Latest canary perf graphs (link to dashboard)
- List of open JIRAs with owners
- Rollback runbook link
- PR notes and smoke-test logs

Misc scratch items (notes to clean up post-meeting):
- Add more granular owner for each feature-flag rule
- Move runbook to /runbooks/release-train/ (ask SRE to confirm path)

Short TL;DR I will read at meeting start:
- "All teams: quick red/yellow/green. We will run through the go/no-go criteria; if we have only minor issues with clear mitigations we can do a soft-go. If any blocking red remains, we will hold launch and schedule immediate triage. Action owners listed in the doc."

End of notes.
